t: This is the Victoria and Albert Museum, the world's largest museum of applied arts, decorative arts and design, with a permanent collection of over 2.8 million objects. It is named for Queen Victoria and her husband, Prince Albert. They married on 10 February 1840, and Victoria gave him the title Prince Consort in 1857. He died in 1861. Victoria reigned from 1837 to 1901, and her long reign gave its name to the Victorian era.
